savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 2005.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Continues fourteen named advisory committees; the President's New Freedom Commission on Mental Health is not on the list.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 6: 'This order shall be effective September 30, 2003.' The revocations in sec. 3 are effective 2003-09-30 (signed September 17, 2003; printed 68 FR 55255-55256, September 23, 2003).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:13263: sec. 3(g) ('Executive Order 13263, establishing the President's New Freedom Commission on Mental Health'), under the lead-in 'which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked'

conclusion: EO 13316 (signed 2003-09-17, 68 FR 55255, PDF pages 1-2, read once in full) continues fourteen advisory committees to 2005-09-30 (sec. 1), assigns FACA functions (sec. 2), revokes nine orders or sections for committees that 'have terminated or whose work is completed' (sec. 3, EO 13263 in 3(g)), supersedes EO 13225 (sec. 4), amends sec. 1-102(a) of EO 12131 (sec. 5) and is effective 2003-09-30 (sec. 6). No savings, transfer or exception provision. The recital does not date the Commission's termination, so it cannot show whether EO 13263's one-year term (to 2003-04-29) was extended first.
